interpretation.com_definition: base-body inertial COM velocity projected into visible base_link axes via model.base_velocity(local=True); controller uses pre-control estimate and score uses post-control truth of the same definition
interpretation.wheel_body_slip_proxy: wheel angular speed times nominal radius minus pre-control body COM forward speed; includes kinematic mismatch, and is not a measured slip ratio
interpretation.p_identity: when body_common_p_active, mean differential wheel PI P plus common wheel P = Kp*(mean wheel target - pre-control body COM speed/radius); otherwise common P is zero and the mean P term = Kp*(mean wheel target - mean wheel omega)
interpretation.timing: controller/calculation uses pre-control state; metrics/body_post uses post-control truth
interpretation.flat_comparator: flat target is 0.6 m/s versus ramp 0.45 m/s; compare tracking errors and control components, not absolute velocities
interpretation.base_ground_query_geom: geom at the base ground-height query; this is not a per-wheel contact or per-geom positive load classification

unidentifiable_from_saved_fields: world-frame COM velocity and exact slope-tangent COM velocity (body COM z velocity is not recorded)
individual wheel longitudinal slip/contact force versus ground; control native summary has only aggregate ramp-family positive load, so per-ramp-geom wheel-load phase attribution is unavailable here
counterfactual effect of changing controller gain, leg target, gravity compensation, or policy action
